dsh-quicksight is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Two-tier image reading for text-only models: fast local OCR (RapidOCR, offline) first, vision-model fallback (modlens).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fb2e4bb773113b23467e.html
